page.overview:
What is Striaton City?

Striaton City is a small urban city in Unova region. To the east of the city lies the Dreamyard, an abandoned factory site. In the western part of the town is a public garden leading to Route 3. In this city, you'll find the region's first Gym, with the Gym Leader dependent on which First partner Pokémon you choose. Professor Juniper's friend, Dr. Fennel, researches Pokémon inside the lab here. Tips for beginner trainers are abundant in the Pokémon Trainers' School, which is to the left of the Pokémon Center.

The Gym Leader is at the Trainers' School, and you'll need to head there before you can challenge the Gym. After winning at the Gym, Fennel is waiting to show you the laboratory and hands you HM01 Cut. She asks you to head to the Dreamyard, where Munna produce the Dream Mist needed for her research. You'll get the C-Gear and Pal Pad as a reward for doing this. Because of the successful experiment, from this point on the Dream World and the facilities on the second floor of Pokémon Centers are accessible.
